display_name: 全球企业软件/云计算/AI平台
sub_industry: 企业软件、超大规模云、生产力平台与AI基础设施
aliases: global enterprise software cloud ai platform
current_cycle_state: Enterprise cloud and generative-AI demand remain the central growth drivers while AI data-center capex, depreciation, power availability, and the timing of Copilot monetization determine near-term free-cash-flow conversion and valuation duration risk.

primary_anchor.method: segment SOTP plus normalized forward PE
primary_anchor.reason: Productivity software, Azure infrastructure/platform services, security, gaming, search, and hardware have different growth, margin, and capital-intensity profiles. Segment economics and normalized operating earnings are more informative than a single historical multiple.

secondary_anchors.reason: Tests whether recurring software and cloud cash generation compensates for the current AI infrastructure capex and depreciation cycle.
Makes the duration sensitivity to Azure growth, cloud gross margin, capex intensity, terminal growth, and discount rates explicit.
Useful only after adjusting Alphabet, Amazon, Oracle, and Salesforce for cloud mix, advertising exposure, capital intensity, and margin structure.

weak_or_floor_anchors.reason: Net cash supports resilience but does not capture the value or risk of recurring software, Azure, distribution, and AI infrastructure.

disabled_anchors.reason: Business mix, AI capex, rates, and growth duration changed materially; a historical percentile cannot establish intrinsic value by itself.
Microsoft includes mature high-margin software, cloud infrastructure, gaming, search, and devices with different economics.

anchor_switch_rationale: Raise FCF-yield weight as AI capex and depreciation normalize. Raise scenario-DCF weight when rate sensitivity or long-dated AI monetization dominates. Use SOTP whenever segment growth or margins diverge materially.
valid_when: segment revenue and operating income are available
Azure and commercial remaining performance obligation growth are disclosed
AI capex, depreciation, cloud capacity constraints, and FCF conversion are modeled
stock-based compensation and net share-count change are reconciled
invalid_when: Azure growth or commercial bookings deteriorate for multiple quarters without an offsetting margin benefit
AI infrastructure utilization fails to justify capex and depreciation
material antitrust, cloud-licensing, export-control, or cybersecurity remedies impair economics
Copilot monetization or enterprise renewal assumptions fail materially
market_pricing_language: Azure and other cloud services growth
AI capex, depreciation, and capacity availability
free cash flow conversion and stock-based compensation
key_cycle_indicators: US real yields and enterprise IT budgets
cloud gross margin and FCF conversion
net share-count change after buybacks and SBC
antitrust, cloud licensing, cybersecurity, and export controls

sources.name: SEC Company Facts for Microsoft Corporation

analyst_notes: Do not treat announced AI demand as realized value. Reconcile Azure growth, RPO, capacity, cloud margin, capex, depreciation, FCF, SBC, executed buybacks, and net share-count change in the same scenario set.
